reason: Requirements + acceptance criteria to verify against: R6 legacy-enterprise inference, R7 USER-only gating on held kind, R9 0600/redaction/no-password, R5 refresh-failure AuthError. Every AC is a check target.

The enforced cli->{api,core}, api->core, core-imports-neither invariant. Must stay green (PRD constraint) — verify no new core<-cli/api import (e.g. oauth.ts loopback stays in cli/commands, auth.ts acquirers stay in core).

If added in A2/A3: verify coerceToken/coerceConfig accept kind/refreshToken/userToken/oauthRedirectUri/authMode, default kind='enterprise' for legacy, and the D2 three-branch inference (userToken->user, token->enterprise, neither->user).

Verify acquireUserToken query shape (authorization_code+code+client_id+client_secret) + refresh_token capture + kind:'user'; refreshUserToken SAME refreshToken retained; ensureFreshToken routes enterprise->client_credentials / user->refresh_token and surfaces AuthError on refresh failure; user-mode inflight serialization.
Verify mode-aware persistToken: user-kind writes userToken+authMode, enterprise-kind writes token+authMode; buildContext loads the ACTIVE slot into ctx.auth.token and stamps ctx.auth.mode.
Verify 401 single-replay still works for BOTH modes (D8, http.ts unchanged): a 401 under a user token force-refreshes and replays once without recursion. Bearer injection unchanged.

Verify refuseUserTokenEndpoint: USER-only endpoints ALLOWED when ctx.auth.mode==='user', REFUSED (UsageError exit 2) when enterprise; AUTHORIZE_HINT + tokenLine/warningsFor copy updated to mention user-token mode.

Verify runLogin: --mode default=user prompt pre-selects user; enterprise branch byte-for-byte unchanged (D11); user path uses getMyself for verifyAccess and prints mode+user; runStatus reports authMode/kind/refresh presence; runLogout clears active slot + --all both (D14); all prompts/URL on stderr, stdout JSON-only in --json.

Verify coerceConfig does NOT drop the new keys (D3 — was a silent-data-loss bug), ConfigPatch covers them, and saveConfig atomic-merge still works. TokenRecord.kind defaults to 'enterprise' when a legacy token omits it (R6).

Verify no client_secret/code/refresh_token leaks in logs (redactUrl on the token-exchange URL); refresh failure is a surfaced AuthError not swallowed; ensureFreshToken keeps single-inflight per active token; enterprise acquireToken unchanged.

If added in D13: verify the loopback binds to ctx.oauth.redirectUri port (default 8732), parses ?code=&domain=, one-shot shutdown, timeout->actionable error, port-busy->actionable error, authorize URL printed to stderr and best-effort opened.
stdout/stderr contract: the authorize URL, code prompt, and loopback lifecycle must be stderr; --json keeps stdout JSON-only. Verify no stray stdout writes in the new login/channel code.
